description: Product-level tactical battle composition. medieval-core owns tactical movement/combat semantics; physics-engine and shared rendering foundations retain their own lower-level performance evidence.

scenarios.description: Six attacker and six defender units advance and engage pairwise over 2,400 deterministic tactical ticks.
correctnessEvidence: identical final TacticalBattle across repeated runs

metrics.name: unit_snapshot_clones
metrics.notes: Whole unit-vector clones during tick advancement. Movement uses copy-on-write before-state and combat pulses read live units, so recurring ticks clone no vector (#200).

metrics.name: unit_snapshot_copies
metrics.notes: Individual units copied right before their own movement step may change them; idle units are not copied.

metrics.name: target_lookup_evaluations
metrics.notes: Remaining linear candidate scans: attack-move acquisition, routed nearest-enemy search and cavalry charge interception. Id lookups are indexed and counted as indexed_unit_lookups.

metrics.name: indexed_unit_lookups
metrics.notes: Binary-search unit lookups by id; one per engagement-target resolution.

scenarios.description: Movement, combat-pulse and single-retarget ticks over a fixed active set (one melee pair, one marching unit) while idle unrelated units grow from 8 to 256; enforced by crates/medieval-core/tests/tactical_operation_scaling.rs.
correctnessEvidence: active units reach identical state at every unrelated population
every work counter except the declared linear movement visit scan is identical across populations
no whole unit-vector clone during recurring ticks

metrics.name: unrelated_unit_work_growth
metrics.notes: Asserted to be zero by the integration test rather than emitted by the smoke command; adopt coding-tooling#300 growth declarations when available.

scenarios.description: Future product evidence should measure renderer-owned snapshot composition separately from medieval-core battle stepping.
correctnessEvidence: BattleRenderSnapshot derives only from authoritative TacticalBattle plus view state

metrics.name: renderables_built
metrics.notes: Add in medieval-renderer without moving generic camera/GPU behavior out of the shared rendering foundation.
